one_liner: 72 of 80 hours — eight short, with clear ways to close the gap

notice.title: Six-month renewal: verify your work hours

situation: 45-year-old warehouse worker whose hours were cut: 64 hours a month now, plus 8 hours a month volunteering at a food pantry. Total 72 — eight hours short of the standard. Has pay stubs and a signed volunteer log.
